title: Workflow Ledger shared event vocabulary
description: Recommended caller-emitted operational event names and attributes. This catalog does not imply that Workflow Ledger emits these events.

ownership.event_names: The agent.* names below are shared recommendations for caller instrumentation.
ownership.workflow_ledger_prefix: Reserved for events emitted by the Workflow Ledger product itself.
ownership.custom_events: Callers may use their own stable dotted namespace for events outside this catalog.

agent.operation.name.description: Stable, low-cardinality name of the operation, not a request, user, or asset identifier.

agent.retry.attempt.description: One-based attempt number for the retry that is about to begin.

agent.retry.reason.description: Normalized reason for retrying; do not put exception messages or request content here.

error.type.description: Low-cardinality error class or stable error code. Reused from OpenTelemetry exception conventions; omit when unknown.

events.name: agent.operation.retrying
events.when: A retry decision has been made and another attempt is about to start.
events.span_relationship: Record only the retry decision. The operation span represents the operation duration and final outcome.

events.name: agent.operation.failed
events.when: An operation has reached a terminal failure and cannot continue or recover.
events.span_relationship: Record a failure detail that is useful to query. The operation span remains the source for duration and outcome.

privacy: Do not record prompts, responses, transcripts, tool arguments or results, credentials, arbitrary exception messages, or other source content by default.

otel_guidance.error_type_attribute: The OpenTelemetry error.type attribute is reused where applicable.
otel_guidance.note: This vocabulary is an Workflow Ledger recommendation, not an OpenTelemetry semantic convention. Recheck upstream convention maturity when revising this catalog.
